system.description:
Spend a Hope to deploy a silent
infiltration asset, such as a microdrone,
optical decoy, or assassination marker.
Until your next rest, the Shadow Asset
can quietly follow a creature, watch a
location, create a distraction, or help
you maintain cover. It can’t physically
manipulate the environment.
When you make a action involving a
creature or location watched by your
Shadow Asset, you gain advantage. L
You can also burn the asset to strike an
adversary. When you do, make an
Interface Roll against a target within
Very Far range.
On a hit, roll a number of d6s equal to
your Interface trait and deal that much
techno damage to the target. The
Shadow Asset then dissipates.
You can only have one Asset at a time.
